Confluence 5: Multi-timeframe Alignment, Quarter Theory, and Supply/Demand align with Standard Deviation (SD). Multi-timeframe analysis reveals a bullish H1 trend consolidating into a sideways H4/M15 range, which represents a classic accumulation phase. The defensive staff zone at 77016.00 - 77120.00 represents the -2.5 Standard Deviation band on the H1 timeframe, indicating an extreme statistical deviation.
